evals.kv: (()=>{const c=[...document.querySelectorAll('.v69-key-values dd code')]; const o=c.filter(e=>e.hasAttribute('tabindex')); const a=o[0]; if(!a) return {codes:c.length,focusable:0}; a.focus(); const s=getComputedStyle(a); return {codes:c.length,focusable:o.length,aria:a.getAttribute('aria-label'),outline:s.outlineStyle+' '+s.outlineWidth+' '+s.outlineColor,active:document.activeElement===a}})()
